instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the entire app supports instant live bilingual switching (FR / EN) using state or i18n context without reloading.
Use dark industrial styling with stark typography: high contrast white text on dark navy/charcoal `#0A0D12` background, accented with safety orange `#FF5500` and cobalt blue machine highlights.
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs, modal triggers, language toggles, table unit switches) MUST have strict kebab-case `data-testid` attributes as listed.
Implement Sonner toast notifications when submitting the quote form or clicking spare part inquiry buttons.
Do not use transparent dropdown backgrounds; ensure all floating overlays have dark blurred backgrounds for legibility.
Make sure product cards allow clicking to open a detailed technical specification modal/sheet for the selected REFRAM™ machine.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons. Use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom selection states, and loading animations.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute.
